Here is the unified character description of Ben 10:

Benjamin "Ben" Kirby Tennyson is the main protagonist of the Ben 10 series. He is a 15-year-old teenager who wields the powerful Prototype Omnitrix, a wristwatch-like device that allows him to transform into numerous alien forms, inheriting the unique abilities of that alien race. Ben is the leader of the group and has matured dramatically over the past five years, gaining strength, leadership, and wisdom. He is voiced by Yuri Lowenthal.

In the reboot series, Ben is a 10-year-old boy who finds the Omnitrix, a mysterious watch that transforms him into 10 different aliens. He is voiced by Tara Strong.

Here is the unified character description of Ben 10:

Benjamin "Ben" Kirby Tennyson, also known as Ben 10, is the main protagonist of the series. At the age of 15, Ben is a teenager who has matured dramatically and gained strength, leadership, and wisdom. He is the grandson of Max Tennyson, a semi-retired member of the Plumbers, and the cousin of Gwen Tennyson. Ben's middle name, Kirby, was conceived as a reference to comic book artist Jack Kirby. He wields the Omnitrix, a wristwatch-shaped device that allows him to transform into numerous alien forms, thereby inheriting the unique abilities of that alien race.

He is the wielder of the powerful Prototype Omnitrix, a wristwatch-shaped device that allows him to transform into numerous alien forms, inheriting the unique abilities of that alien race. Ben is a leader and has taken on a more responsible role after Grandpa Max's disappearance. He is voiced by Yuri Lowenthal.

In the reboot series, Ben is a 10-year-old boy who has spent his summer vacation traveling across the country with his cousin Gwen and Grandpa Max. After coming across a strange high-tech watch known as the Omnitrix, which enables him to transform into 10 alien heroes, he finds himself in the position of a superhero. He is voiced by Tara Strong in the reboot series.

Ben is a brave and determined hero who is always ready to defend the Earth and other parts of the universe from villainous alien activity. He is a bit reckless and impulsive at times, but he always means well and tries to do the right thing.
